description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different fine-tuning methods, measured by GLUE score, for RoBERTa models of varying sizes. The x-axis represents the fine-tuning method, which includes Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model. The y-axis indicates the GLUE score, ranging from approximately 84 to 89. The chart compares two RoBERTa sizes: base and large. The base size is represented by blue bars, while the large size is represented by orange bars. The Adaptor method shows a significant difference in performance between the base and large sizes, with the large size outperforming the base. LoRA also shows a notable difference, with the large size achieving a higher GLUE score. BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model methods show varying degrees of performance, with the large size generally outperforming the base size. The chart does not include any visual emphasis such as shading or outlining on the bars.
